title: Tiphys canonical gate registry
description: One registry per repository: which gates exist, how each is invoked and verified, which modes and CI events select it, and which commands can destroy work.

kind.description: The artifact type, so `tiphys validate --type auto` resolves this document without being told.

note.description: Free prose for the registry's own readers.

gates.description: Keyed by id; no minItems, and the runner refuses a registry that declares no gate for the requested mode and event.

destructiveCommands.description: CLI commands and module paths whose operations can destroy work; the red-witness gate derives a witness class from this list.

commandArray.description: argv array; the runner appends --result and --evidence, plus one flag per declared parameter.

probeId.description: The checklist probe id M3-P7 must supply. Required exactly when verified-by is clean-room-checklist.

command.description: argv array, run in the repository root.

$comment.description: Clause ids this entry discharges, per schemas/README.md.

prevents.description: DR-0061 (b): the concrete failure this gate prevents, in one line. No line break.

applicability.description: required: an unmet precondition fails the run. conditional: an unmet precondition does not.

modes.description: The assurance modes that select this gate; tiphys mode show derives a mode's gates from this list.

events.description: The CI events whose run evaluates this gate; tiphys gates run --event selects the gates whose list names it.

parameters.description: Run parameters this gate's command requires; an absent declared parameter makes the gate error, never not-applicable (M2-C-3). The exception is event: a run naming no --event is a run over every gate, so a gate declaring event is then told nothing and takes its no-event arm.

kind.description: The closed set. Kind-specific required fields are checked by src/gates/manifest.ts, which emits the same INVALID <pointer> <message> diagnostics.

pattern.description: branch-matches: a JavaScript regular expression compiled as ^(?:<pattern>)$ against the whole branch name, with {phase} replaced by the regex-escaped --phase value.

paths.description: diff-touches. Path prefixes; the precondition is met when the diff changes a path under any of them.

command.description: command-exit-zero. argv array, run in the runner's working directory.
